reproduction_sources.stackd-public-tap-probe.py:
import fcntl,os,select,struct,sys,time
from scapy.all import ARP,Ether,IP,TCP,Raw
name,mac,bridge_mac,private=sys.argv[1:]
fd=os.open('/dev/net/tun',os.O_RDWR|os.O_NONBLOCK)
fcntl.ioctl(fd,0x400454ca,struct.pack('16sH',name.encode(),0x1002))
seq=61000;ack=0;port=42731

def send(flags,data=b''):
 global seq
 packet=Ether(src=mac,dst=bridge_mac)/IP(src=private,dst='169.254.169.254')/TCP(sport=port,dport=80,seq=seq,ack=ack,flags=flags)
 if data:packet=packet/Raw(data)
 os.write(fd,bytes(packet));seq+=len(data)+(1 if 'S' in flags or 'F' in flags else 0)

send('S');deadline=time.monotonic()+8;response=b'';requested=False
while time.monotonic()<deadline:
 if not select.select([fd],[],[],.5)[0]:continue
 packet=Ether(os.read(fd,65536))
 if ARP in packet and packet[ARP].op==1 and packet[ARP].pdst==private:
  os.write(fd,bytes(Ether(src=mac,dst=packet.src)/ARP(op=2,hwsrc=mac,psrc=private,hwdst=packet[ARP].hwsrc,pdst=packet[ARP].psrc)));continue
 if IP not in packet or TCP not in packet or packet[IP].src!='169.254.169.254' or packet[TCP].dport!=port:continue
 tcp=packet[TCP];data=bytes(tcp.payload)
 if not requested and tcp.flags.S and tcp.flags.A:
  ack=tcp.seq+1;send('A');send('PA',b'GET /latest/meta-data/instance-id HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: 169.254.169.254\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n');requested=True
 elif data:
  if tcp.seq==ack:response+=data;ack+=len(data)
  send('A')
  if b'metadata-private-ok' in response:send('FA');print(response.decode());break
else:raise RuntimeError('private TAP metadata exchange did not complete: '+repr(response))
os.close(fd)

limitations: Benchmark IPv4 is host-local, not Internet-advertised; external destinations see the Docker host source.
Physical smoke uses real Docker peers, native guest TAP/IMDS and dnsmasq; it does not boot QEMU or exercise service SQLite in this worker.
Public mapping requires local rootful Docker iptables-nft DOCKER-USER/raw chains and native NET_ADMIN.
Callers serialize fresh authoritative reads with installs; no native control-plane generation registry.
